content.text: Robot Programming: four programs, one robot.

Each program does exactly one job, and each one is short enough to read in a sitting. You start with the smallest program that can possibly work: twelve numbers that make the robot stand up on its own. Then it walks from your phone, then it dances, and finally it obeys your voice.
Program 1 - standing pose: twelve numbers, one upright robot.
Program 2 - WiFi remote: walk and act from a phone browser.
Program 3 - dance show: arrange named moves into a performance.
Program 4 - talk to it: the AI module sends a phrase over UART, the robot acts.
Extra - add a second pose, your own web button and your own voice command.
Drive all twelve servos from one dictionary and explain why a 50 Hz PWM duty value turns into a servo angle.
Write the standing pose from one dictionary, and tune it one value at a time by watching which way the robot falls.
Serve a web page from the ESP32 and walk the robot by tapping buttons on a phone.
Arrange named moves into a dance show by editing a single function.
Read a phrase from an AI module over UART and run the matching action.
(Extra) Add a second pose, one new web button and one new voice command of your own.
A motor with built-in feedback that holds a commanded angle, usually 0-180 degrees, driven by a pulse every 20 ms.
The width of the pulse inside each 20 ms period. On the ESP32 duty runs 0-1023, so 26 is 0 deg and 127 is 180 deg.
The set of twelve angles that makes one particular robot stand straight - every robot has its own.
A complete assignment of angles to all twelve joints; standing is one pose, bowing is another.
A repeating pattern of leg movements that moves the body forward without falling over.
A two-wire serial link (TX to RX, plus GND) that carries plain text between the AI module and the ESP32.
🧍 One program, one job: write twelve angles once and let the robot stand. No walking, no dancing, no sensor, no screen - if this one is wrong, nothing after it can be right.
into Thonny and save it to the robot as
Hold the robot upright while it boots, then let go and watch which way it falls.
, save, and run again until it holds itself up.
🔌 Thirty-seven lines, and most of them are numbers. There is no loop body worth speaking of: the program writes all twelve joints once at start-up, then sleeps forever.

# Biped robot - standing pose only.
# Writes every joint once from ANG, then holds still.
# To tune: edit a value in ANG, save, and run again.

from machine import Pin, PWM
import time

# Standing pose: body upright, both arms hanging straight down.
ANG = {'leg_r': 30, 'knee_r': 54, 'ankle_r': 91,
       'leg_l': 150, 'knee_l': 142, 'ankle_l': 95,
       'shoulder_r': 32, 'arm_r': 144, 'hand_r': 40,
       'shoulder_l': 150, 'arm_l': 37, 'hand_l': 130}

PINS = {'leg_r': 14, 'knee_r': 13, 'ankle_r': 12,
        'leg_l': 5, 'knee_l': 4, 'ankle_l': 2,
        'shoulder_r': 15, 'arm_r': 25, 'hand_r': 26,
        'shoulder_l': 27, 'arm_l': 32, 'hand_l': 33}

srv = {j: PWM(Pin(p, Pin.OUT), freq=50) for j, p in PINS.items()}


def w(joint, deg):
    # 0 deg needs a 0.5 ms pulse, 180 deg needs 2.5 ms. At 50 Hz duty() spans
    # 0..1023, so 0 deg is 26 counts and 180 deg is 127: duty = deg * 0.56 + 25.
    srv[joint].duty(int(deg * 0.56) + 25)


def stand():
    # Write every joint to its ANG value.
    for j, d in ANG.items():
        w(j, d)


stand()

while True:
    time.sleep(1)
🧩 Two dictionaries carry the whole program.
says which GPIO pin drives which joint;
says what angle that joint should hold. Both are keyed by a name you can read, so
needs no comment to be understood - and the old
style, where you had to remember that number 4 was the left knee, is gone.
⚙️ The only arithmetic in the file is the duty conversion. A servo wants a 0.5 ms pulse for 0 degrees and 2.5 ms for 180, out of a 20 ms period. At 50 Hz the ESP32
spans 0..1023 across those 20 ms, so 0 degrees is 26 counts and 180 degrees is 127 counts. Interpolating between them gives
; change the PWM frequency and this constant changes with it.

just walks the dictionary and writes every joint. It runs exactly once, and calling it again moves nothing because the servos are already there - which is all you want from a program whose entire job is "hold this pose".

👀 There is no sensor here, so your eyes are the instrument. Power on, hold the robot for a second, let go. If it stays up, the table is right. If it drops forward, backward or sideways, exactly one number is wrong - and the direction of the fall tells you which one.
leg_r down 2, leg_l up 2 - the body leans back
leg_r up 2, leg_l down 2 - the body leans forward
raise both ankles 3 - the body tilts back to the left
compare the two arms, move the low one up 3
a joint buzzes or gets warm
move it 5 back toward the middle of its range
One row at a time. Change two numbers and you will not know which one helped.
Two or three degrees is a visible change on this robot; one degree usually is not.
Write the final table down. Programs 2, 3 and 4 carry the same twelve numbers - copy your finished
into them, or the robot will stand differently in each lesson.
🔍 The left side is the mirror of the right, and the numbers show it:

150 is almost exactly 180 minus, because the two servo horns are mounted opposite ways. But 54 and 142 for the knees are not, and neither are the arms. That is the lesson: you cannot calculate the partner, you measure it - which is why the table above says "compare the two" instead of "add 180".
↔️ If a correction makes the fall worse instead of better, go the other way on that joint. The sign depends on which way the horn was mounted, and no amount of reasoning beats one five second test.
📱 One program, one job: the robot joins your WiFi and serves a page with eight buttons.
Put your WiFi name and password in
Run it and copy the IP address printed in the Shell.
Open that address on a phone that is on the same WiFi, then press Forward.
🔌 Program 2 is the walking code plus a forty-line web server. The page is a single string, the server is one
loop that answers one request at a time.

# ============================================================ # Biped robot - Program 2: WiFi remote # # The robot joins your WiFi and serves a small web page. # Open that page on a phone in the same network and press the buttons. # # How to use: # 1) Put your WiFi name and password in WIFI_SSID / WIFI_PASS. # 2) Paste this file into Thonny, save it to the robot as main.py. # 3) Run it and read the IP address in the Shell, e.g. 192.168.1.23 # 4) Type that address into the phone browser. Keep the phone on the # same WiFi - the robot has no internet access. # ============================================================ import time import network import socket from machine import Pin, PWM # ---------- 1. Calibration (same table as Program 1) ---------- ANG = {'leg_r': 30, 'knee_r': 54, 'ankle_r': 91, 'leg_l': 150, 'knee_l': 142, 'ankle_l': 95, 'shoulder_r': 32, 'arm_r': 144, 'hand_r': 40, 'shoulder_l': 150, 'arm_l': 37, 'hand_l': 130} LEAN = 0 # extra forward lean while walking; 0 = the same pose as Program 1 SPEED = 2 # gait speed, larger value = slower AHEAD_R = 12 # side tilt (right) used to free the left foot when walking forward AHEAD_L = 12 # side tilt (left) used to free the right foot when walking forward BACK_R = 12 # side tilt used when walking backwards BACK_L = 12 KICK_DEG = 14 # body tilt while kicking RISE_DEG = 17 # thigh tuck angle used when standing up from the floor WIFI_SSID = 'MINXIN-S' WIFI_PASS = 'Minxin520' # ---------- 2. Hardware ---------- PINS = {'leg_r': 14, 'knee_r': 13, 'ankle_r': 12, 'leg_l': 5, 'knee_l': 4, 'ankle_l': 2, 'shoulder_r': 15, 'arm_r': 25, 'hand_r': 26, 'shoulder_l': 27, 'arm_l': 32, 'hand_l': 33} LEG_R = ANG['leg_r'] + LEAN # right leg angle in the standing pose LEG_L = ANG['leg_l'] - LEAN # left leg angle in the standing pose srv = {j: PWM(Pin(p, Pin.OUT), freq=50) for j, p in PINS.items()} # Last angle we told each servo to go to. Taken from the calibration table, so at # power-up the pose is known without reading anything back from the PWM hardware. pos = dict(ANG) pos['leg_r'], pos['leg_l'] = LEG_R, LEG_L def w(joint, deg): """Set one joint to an angle in degrees.""" pos[joint] = int(deg) srv[joint].duty(int(deg * 0.56) + 25) def stand(force=False): """Ease every servo back to the standing pose, all at the same time. With force=True the standing angles are written again even if the code already thinks the robot is standing, so /reset really re-drives the servos. """ target = dict(ANG) target['leg_r'], target['leg_l'] = LEG_R, LEG_L while pos != target: for j in srv: if pos[j] < target[j]: w(j, pos[j] + 1) elif pos[j] > target[j]: w(j, pos[j] - 1) time.sleep_ms(10) if force: for j, d in target.items(): w(j, d) # ---------- 3. Motions ---------- def goahead(steps=5): """Walk forward the given number of full gait cycles.""" stand() w('leg_r', LEG_R - 2) w('leg_l', LEG_L + 2) time.sleep_ms(200) # Shift the weight, step with the left leg. for a in range(AHEAD_R): w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] - a) w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - 5 - a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 10 + 30) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 100 + 200) w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - AHEAD_R) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 50) for a in range(13): w('leg_r', LEG_R - a - 2) w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] - a) w('leg_l', LEG_L - a - 4) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] - a + 4) w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] + 2 * a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 10 + 30) # Level the body, shift to the other side, step with the right leg. for a in range(AHEAD_R): w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] - AHEAD_R + a) w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - AHEAD_R + a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 20 + 20) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 100 + 500) for a in range(AHEAD_L): w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] + a) w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + 5 + a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 10 + 30) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 100 + 200) w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + AHEAD_L) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 50) for a in range(13): w('leg_r', LEG_R - 15 + a) w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] - 13 + a) w('leg_l', LEG_L - 13 + a - 2) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] - 13 + a) w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] - 2 * a + 52) w('shoulder_l', ANG['shoulder_l'] - 2 * a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 10 + 20) # Remaining gait cycles. for _ in range(steps): for a in range(13): w('leg_r', LEG_R + a - 2) w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] + a - 3) w('leg_l', LEG_L + a - 2) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] + a - 3) w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] - 2 * a + 26) w('shoulder_l', ANG['shoulder_l'] - 2 * a - 26) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 10 + 20) for a in range(AHEAD_L): w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + AHEAD_L - a) w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] + AHEAD_L - a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 20 + 20) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 100 + 500) for a in range(AHEAD_R): w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] - a) w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - 5 - a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 20 + 20) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 100) w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - AHEAD_R) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 50) for a in range(13): w('leg_r', LEG_R + 13 - a - 2) w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] + 13 - a) w('leg_l', LEG_L + 13 - a - 4) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] + 13 - a + 4) w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] + 2 * a) w('shoulder_l', ANG['shoulder_l'] + 2 * a - 52) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 10 + 20) for a in range(13): w('leg_r', LEG_R - a - 2) w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] - a) w('leg_l', LEG_L - a + 1) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] - a + 4) w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] + 26 + 2 * a) w('shoulder_l', ANG['shoulder_l'] + 2 * a - 26) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 10 + 20) for a in range(AHEAD_R): w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] - AHEAD_R + a) w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - AHEAD_R + a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 20 + 20) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 100 + 500) for a in range(AHEAD_L): w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] + a) w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + 5 + a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 20 + 20) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 100 + 200) w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + AHEAD_L) time.sleep_ms(50) for a in range(13): w('leg_r', LEG_R - 13 + a - 2) w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] - 13 + a - 3) w('leg_l', LEG_L - 13 + a - 2) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] - 13 + a) w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] - 2 * a + 52) w('shoulder_l', ANG['shoulder_l'] - 2 * a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 10 + 20) stand() def goback(steps=5): """Walk backwards the given number of full gait cycles.""" stand() for a in range(3): w('leg_r', LEG_R + a) w('leg_l', LEG_L - a) time.sleep_ms(50) for a in range(BACK_R): w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] - a) w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - 5 - a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 10 + 20) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 100 + 200) w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - BACK_R) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 50 + 50) for a in range(15): w('leg_r', LEG_R + a + 3) w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] + a) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] - a / 3) w('shoulder_l', ANG['shoulder_l'] - 2 * a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 10 + 20) for a in range(BACK_R): w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] - BACK_R + a) w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - BACK_R + a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 20 + 20) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l']) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 100 + 500) for a in range(BACK_L): w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] + a) w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + 5 + a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 20 + 20) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 100 + 200) w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + BACK_L) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 50) for _ in range(steps): for a in range(15): w('leg_r', LEG_R + 15 - a + 3) w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] + 15 - a + 5) w('leg_l', LEG_L - 3 - a) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] - a) w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] + 2 * a) w('shoulder_l', ANG['shoulder_l'] - 30 + 2 * a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 20 + 20) for a in range(BACK_L): w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + BACK_L - a) w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] + BACK_L - a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 20 + 20) w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r']) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 100 + 500) for a in range(BACK_R): w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] - a) w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - 5 - a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 20 + 30) w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - BACK_R) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 50 + 50) for a in range(15): w('leg_r', LEG_R + a + 3) w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] + a) w('leg_l', LEG_L - 15 + a - 3) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] - 15 + a + 5) w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] + 30 - 2 * a) w('shoulder_l', ANG['shoulder_l'] - 2 * a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 10 + 30) for a in range(BACK_R): w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] - BACK_R + a) w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - BACK_R + a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 20 + 20) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l']) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 100 + 500) for a in range(BACK_L): w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] + a) w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + 5 + a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 20 + 20) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 100 + 200) w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + BACK_L) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 50) stand() def turnleft(): """Turn in place to the left once.""" for a in range(11): w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + 5 + a) w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] + a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 10 + 20) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 50 + 50) for a in range(16): w('leg_l', ANG['leg_l'] + a) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] + a) w('leg_r', ANG['leg_r'] + a) w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] + a) time.sleep_ms(40) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 50 + 50) for a in range(12): w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] + 10 - a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 30 + 30) for a in range(16): w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + 16 - a) time.sleep_ms(20) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 100 + 200) for a in range(16): w('leg_l', ANG['leg_l'] + 15 - a) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] + 15 - a) w('leg_r', ANG['leg_r'] + 15 - a) w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] + 15 - a) time.sleep_ms(10) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 50 + 50) def turnright(): """Turn in place to the right once.""" for a in range(11): w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] - a) w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - 5 - a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 10 + 20) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 50 + 50) for a in range(16): w('leg_l', ANG['leg_l'] - a) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] - a) w('leg_r', ANG['leg_r'] - a) w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] - a) time.sleep_ms(40) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] - 16 + 6) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 20 + 50) for a in range(11): w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] - 11 + a + 3) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 30 + 30) for a in range(16): w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - 16 + a) time.sleep_ms(20) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 100 + 200) for a in range(16): w('leg_l', ANG['leg_l'] - 15 + a) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] - 15 + a) w('leg_r', ANG['leg_r'] - 15 + a) w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] - 15 + a) time.sleep_ms(10) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 50 + 50) def kick(): """Lean, swing the right leg back and kick.""" for a in range(9): w('leg_r', LEG_R + a) w('leg_l', LEG_L - a) time.sleep_ms(50) for a in range(15): w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + a) time.sleep_ms(10) for a in range(KICK_DEG): w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + 15 + a) w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] + a) time.sleep_ms(80) for a in range(15): w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + 30 - a) time.sleep_ms(10) for a in range(30): w('leg_r', LEG_R + 10 - a) w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] + 2 * a) w('shoulder_l', ANG['shoulder_l'] - 2 * a) w('hand_l', ANG['hand_l'] - 2 * a) time.sleep_ms(20) time.sleep_ms(1000) w('leg_r', LEG_R + 60) w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] + 10) time.sleep_ms(1000) stand() def pushup(): """Lie down on the hands, do three push-ups, then stand up.""" for a in range(114): w('leg_r', ANG['leg_r'] + a) w('leg_l', ANG['leg_l'] - a) w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] + a / 2) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] - a / 2) time.sleep_ms(30) for a in range(90): w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] + a) w('shoulder_l', ANG['shoulder_l'] - a) time.sleep_ms(5) for a in range(57): w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] + 57 - a) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] - 57 + a) time.sleep_ms(10) for a in range(114): w('leg_r', LEG_R + 114 - a) w('leg_l', LEG_L - 114 + a) time.sleep_ms(10) time.sleep_ms(300) for _ in range(3): # number of push-ups for a in range(50): w('arm_r', ANG['arm_r'] - a) w('hand_r', ANG['hand_r'] + 2 * a) w('arm_l', ANG['arm_l'] + a) w('hand_l', ANG['hand_l'] - 2 * a) time.sleep_ms(10) for a in range(50): w('arm_r', ANG['arm_r'] - 50 + a) w('hand_r', ANG['hand_r'] + 100 - 2 * a) w('arm_l', ANG['arm_l'] + 50 - a) w('hand_l', ANG['hand_l'] - 100 + 2 * a) time.sleep_ms(10) for a in range(100 + RISE_DEG): # tuck the thighs w('leg_r', LEG_R + a) w('leg_l', LEG_L - a) time.sleep_ms(10) time.sleep_ms(500) for a in range(60): w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] + a) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] - a) time.sleep_ms(30) for a in range(90): w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] + 90 - a) w('shoulder_l', ANG['shoulder_l'] - 90 + a) time.sleep_ms(5) for a in range(10): w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] + 60 + a) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] - 60 - a) time.sleep_ms(5) for a in range(10): w('leg_r', LEG_R + 100 + RISE_DEG - a) w('leg_l', LEG_L - 100 - RISE_DEG + a) time.sleep_ms(3) for a in range(RISE_DEG): w('leg_r', LEG_R + 90 + RISE_DEG - a) w('leg_l', LEG_L - 90 - RISE_DEG + a) time.sleep_ms(30) time.sleep_ms(100) for a in range(15): w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] + 70 - a) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] - 70 + a) w('leg_r', LEG_R + 92 - a) w('leg_l', LEG_L - 92 + a) time.sleep_ms(50) time.sleep_ms(100) for a in range(15): w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] + 55 - a) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] - 55 + a) w('leg_r', LEG_R + 77 - a) w('leg_l', LEG_L - 77 + a) time.sleep_ms(50) time.sleep_ms(100) for a in range(10): w('leg_r', LEG_R + 62 - a) w('leg_l', LEG_L - 62 + a) time.sleep_ms(50) for a in range(40): w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] + 40 - a) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] - 40 + a) w('leg_r', LEG_R + 52 - a) w('leg_l', LEG_L - 52 + a) time.sleep_ms(50) for a in range(12): w('leg_r', LEG_R + 12 - a) w('leg_l', LEG_L - 12 + a) time.sleep_ms(50) def punch(): """Bend down, raise both fists and throw five punches.""" stand() for a in range(30): w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] + a) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] - a) w('leg_r', LEG_R + 2 * a) w('leg_l', LEG_L - 2 * a) time.sleep_ms(50) for a in range(25): w('leg_r', LEG_R + 60 - a) w('leg_l', LEG_L - 60 + a) time.sleep_ms(50) time.sleep_ms(100) time.sleep_ms(300) w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] + 110) w('shoulder_l', ANG['shoulder_l'] - 110) time.sleep_ms(100) for a in range(60): # pull the fists in w('arm_r', ANG['arm_r'] - a) w('hand_r', ANG['hand_r'] + 2 * a) w('arm_l', ANG['arm_l'] + a) w('hand_l', ANG['hand_l'] - 2 * a) time.sleep_ms(10) time.sleep_ms(500) for a in range(60): w('arm_r', ANG['arm_r'] - # ============================================================
# Biped robot - Program 3: dance show
#
# Seven moves, each one a plain loop, plus a show() that strings them
# together. Change the order in show() and you have a new performance.
#
# How to use:
#   1) Paste this file into Thonny, save it to the robot as main.py.
#   2) Run it. The robot stands up, dances one round, then repeats.
#   3) Put the robot on a table with 1 m of clear space around it.
#
# Warning: the first move folds the body forward 70 deg. If your robot tends
# to fall forward, raise LEAN above 0 before dancing.
# ============================================================

from machine import Pin, PWM
import time

# ---------- 1. Calibration (same table as Program 1 and 2) ----------
ANG = {'leg_r': 30, 'knee_r': 54, 'ankle_r': 91,
       'leg_l': 150, 'knee_l': 142, 'ankle_l': 95,
       'shoulder_r': 32, 'arm_r': 144, 'hand_r': 40,
       'shoulder_l': 150, 'arm_l': 37, 'hand_l': 130}

LEAN = 0   # extra forward lean while walking; 0 = the same pose as Program 1

PINS = {'leg_r': 14, 'knee_r': 13, 'ankle_r': 12,
        'leg_l': 5, 'knee_l': 4, 'ankle_l': 2,
        'shoulder_r': 15, 'arm_r': 25, 'hand_r': 26,
        'shoulder_l': 27, 'arm_l': 32, 'hand_l': 33}

LEG_R = ANG['leg_r'] + LEAN
LEG_L = ANG['leg_l'] - LEAN

srv = {j: PWM(Pin(p, Pin.OUT), freq=50) for j, p in PINS.items()}
pos = dict(ANG)
pos['leg_r'], pos['leg_l'] = LEG_R, LEG_L


def w(joint, deg):
    """Set one joint to an angle in degrees."""
    pos[joint] = int(deg)
    srv[joint].duty(int(deg * 0.56) + 25)


def stand():
    """Ease every joint back to the standing pose, all at the same time."""
    target = dict(ANG)
    target['leg_r'], target['leg_l'] = LEG_R, LEG_L
    while pos != target:
        for j in ANG:
            if pos[j] < target[j]:
                w(j, pos[j] + 1)
            elif pos[j] > target[j]:
                w(j, pos[j] - 1)
        time.sleep_ms(8)


# ---------- 2. The moves ----------
# Every move is the same shape: a loop that walks one variable from 0 to N,
# with each joint written as  base + k * variable.  Change k and the joint
# moves further; change the loop length and the move gets slower.
# Reminder for the signs: right side = bigger angle lifts, left side = smaller.

def bow():                              # 鞠躬 - fold forward from the hips
    for a in range(70):
        w('leg_r', ANG['leg_r'] + a)
        w('leg_l', ANG['leg_l'] - a)
        w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] + a / 2)
        w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] - a / 2)
        w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] + a)
        w('hand_r', ANG['hand_r'] + a)
        time.sleep_ms(10)
    time.sleep_ms(600)
    for a in range(70):
        w('leg_r', ANG['leg_r'] + 70 - a)
        w('leg_l', ANG['leg_l'] - 70 + a)
        w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] + 35 - a / 2)
        w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] - 35 + a / 2)
        w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] + 70 - a)
        w('hand_r', ANG['hand_r'] + 70 - a)
        time.sleep_ms(10)


def nod():                              # 点头 - tap the right toe twice
    for _ in range(2):
        for a in range(14):
            w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + a)
            time.sleep_ms(17)
        for a in range(14):
            w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + 13 - a)
            time.sleep_ms(17)


def twist():                            # 扭胯 - hips sway, arms punch out one at a time
    for _ in range(4):
        for a in range(14):
            w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + a)
            w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - a)
            w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] + 100 - 2 * a)
            w('hand_r', ANG['hand_r'] + 70)
            w('arm_l', ANG['arm_l'] + 90 - 2 * a)
            w('hand_l', ANG['hand_l'] + 2 * a)
            time.sleep_ms(17)
        for a in range(14):
            w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + 14 - a)
            w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - 14 + a)
            w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] + 72 + 2 * a)
            w('hand_r', ANG['hand_r'] + 70)
            w('arm_l', ANG['arm_l'] + 62 + 2 * a)
            w('hand_l', ANG['hand_l'] + 28 - 2 * a)
            time.sleep_ms(17)
    for _ in range(4):
        for a in range(14):
            w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + a)
            w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - a)
            w('shoulder_l', ANG['shoulder_l'] - 100 + 2 * a)
            w('hand_l', ANG['hand_l'] - 70)
            w('arm_r', ANG['arm_r'] - 90 + 2 * a)
            w('hand_r', ANG['hand_r'] - 2 * a)
            time.sleep_ms(17)
        for a in range(14):
            w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + 14 - a)
            w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - 14 + a)
            w('shoulder_l', ANG['shoulder_l'] - 72 - 2 * a)
            w('hand_l', ANG['hand_l'] - 70)
            w('arm_r', ANG['arm_r'] - 62 - 2 * a)
            w('hand_r', ANG['hand_r'] - 28 + 2 * a)
            time.sleep_ms(17)


def flap():                             # 摆臂 - both arms swing like wings
    for _ in range(4):
        for a in range(14):
            w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + a)
            w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - a)
            w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] + 80 - 2 * a)
            w('arm_r', ANG['arm_r'] - 90)
            w('hand_r', ANG['hand_r'] + 90)
            w('arm_l', ANG['arm_l'] + 2 * a)
            w('hand_l', ANG['hand_l'] - 4 * a)
            time.sleep_ms(17)
        for a in range(14):
            w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + 14 - a)
            w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - 14 + a)
            w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] + 52 + 2 * a)
            w('arm_r', ANG['arm_r'] - 90)
            w('hand_r', ANG['hand_r'] + 90)
            w('arm_l', ANG['arm_l'] + 28 - 2 * a)
            w('hand_l', ANG['hand_l'] - 56 + 4 * a)
            time.sleep_ms(17)
    for _ in range(4):
        for a in range(14):
            w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + a)
            w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - a)
            w('shoulder_l', ANG['shoulder_l'] - 140 + 2 * a)
            w('arm_l', ANG['arm_l'] + 90)
            w('hand_l', ANG['hand_l'] - 90)
            w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] + 140 - 2 * a)
            w('arm_r', ANG['arm_r'] - 90)
            w('hand_r', ANG['hand_r'] + 90)
            time.sleep_ms(17)
        for a in range(14):
            w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + 14 - a)
            w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - 14 + a)
            w('shoulder_l', ANG['shoulder_l'] - 112 - 2 * a)
            w('arm_l', ANG['arm_l'] + 90)
            w('hand_l', ANG['hand_l'] - 90)
            w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] + 112 + 2 * a)
            w('arm_r', ANG['arm_r'] - 90)
            w('hand_r', ANG['hand_r'] + 90)
            time.sleep_ms(17)


def toe_tap():                          # 点脚 - toe taps while both arms are up
    w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] + 90)
    w('shoulder_l', ANG['shoulder_l'] - 90)
    w('hand_r', ANG['hand_r'] + 90)
    w('hand_l', ANG['hand_l'] - 90)
    for a in range(14):
        w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + a)
        w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] + 75 + 2 * a)
        w('shoulder_l', ANG['shoulder_l'] - 105 + 2 * a)
        time.sleep_ms(17)
    for a in range(14):
        w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + 13 - a)
        w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] + 103 - 2 * a)
        w('shoulder_l', ANG['shoulder_l'] - 77 - 2 * a)
        time.sleep_ms(17)


def fan(base, step, open_arm):
    """One 20-step slice of the peacock move.

    base = where the hips start, step = +1 while going down, -1 while coming up,
    open_arm picks which of the two arm poses this slice uses.
    """
    if open_arm:
        w('arm_r', ANG['arm_r'] - 70)
        w('hand_r', ANG['hand_r'] - 60)
        w('arm_l', ANG['arm_l'] + 130)
        w('hand_l', ANG['hand_l'] - 30)
    else:
        w('arm_r', ANG['arm_r'] - 130)
        w('hand_r', ANG['hand_r'] + 30)
        w('arm_l', ANG['arm_l'] + 70)
        w('hand_l', ANG['hand_l'] + 60)
    for a in range(20):
        h = base + step * a
        w('leg_r', ANG['leg_r'] + h)
        w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] + h / 2)
        w('leg_l', ANG['leg_l'] - h)
        w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] - h / 2)
        time.sleep_ms(25)


def peacock():                          # 孔雀开屏 - deep squat, arms open and close
    w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] + 70)
    w('shoulder_l', ANG['shoulder_l'] - 70)
    fan(0, 1, True)
    fan(20, 1, False)
    fan(40, 1, True)
    fan(60, 1, False)
    fan(80, -1, True)
    fan(60, -1, False)
    fan(40, -1, True)
    fan(20, -1, False)


def lotus():                            # 莲花手 - the arm flourish at the end
    w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'])
    w('shoulder_l', ANG['shoulder_l'])
    w('arm_r', ANG['arm_r'] - 100)
    w('arm_l', ANG['arm_l'] + 100)
    w('hand_r', ANG['hand_r'])
    for a in range(20):
        w('hand_l', ANG['hand_l'] + a)
        time.sleep_ms(8)
    for a in range(40):
        w('hand_l', ANG['hand_l'] + 20 - 2 * a)
        w('arm_l', ANG['arm_l'] + 100 + a)
        time.sleep_ms(8)
    for a in range(40):
        w('arm_l', ANG['arm_l'] + 140 - a)
        time.sleep_ms(8)
    for a in range(20):
        w('hand_l', ANG['hand_l'] - 60 + 4 * a)
        w('arm_l', ANG['arm_l'] + 100 - a)
        w('hand_r', ANG['hand_r'] + a)
        w('arm_r', ANG['arm_r'] - 100 - a)
        time.sleep_ms(8)
    for a in range(20):
        w('hand_l', ANG['hand_l'] + 20 - a)
        w('arm_l', ANG['arm_l'] + 80 + a)
        w('hand_r', ANG['hand_r'] + 20 + 2 * a)
        w('arm_r', ANG['arm_r'] - 120 - a)
        time.sleep_ms(8)
    for a in range(40):
        w('arm_r', ANG['arm_r'] - 140 + a)
        time.sleep_ms(8)
    for a in range(20):
        w('hand_r', ANG['hand_r'] + 60 - 4 * a)
        w('arm_r', ANG['arm_r'] - 100 + a)
        time.sleep_ms(8)
    for a in range(20):
        w('hand_r', ANG['hand_r'] - 20 + a)
        w('arm_r', ANG['arm_r'] - 80 - a)
        time.sleep_ms(8)


# ---------- 3. The show ----------
# One line per move. Reorder them, repeat them, delete them - that is the
# whole choreography language.
def show():
    stand()
    nod()
    nod()
    twist()
    twist()
    flap()
    toe_tap()
    toe_tap()
    toe_tap()
    toe_tap()
    peacock()
    lotus()
    lotus()
    bow()
    stand()


# ---------- 4. Run ----------
stand()
time.sleep(1)

while True:
    show()
    time.sleep(2)

is the choreography, and it is deliberately boring: one function call per line, repeats written out. If you want the robot to bow twice at the end, copy the line. # ============================================================
# Biped robot - Program 4: talk to it
#
# The AI is NOT in this program. The AI module (XIAO ZHI) does the
# listening and the thinking, then sends one short Chinese phrase over
# UART. This program only has to recognise that phrase and act.
#
# How to use:
#   1) Wire the AI module to UART2: its TX -> GPIO16 (RX), its RX -> GPIO17,
#      and share GND. Baud rate 115200.
#   2) Paste this file into Thonny, save it to the robot as main.py.
#   3) Paste the prompt of section 3 into the AI module (see the chapter).
#   4) Say "挥挥手" and watch the OLED face change, then the arm move.
# ============================================================

from machine import Pin, PWM, UART, I2C
import ssd1306
import time

# ---------- 1. Calibration (same table as Program 1-3) ----------
ANG = {'leg_r': 30, 'knee_r': 54, 'ankle_r': 91,
       'leg_l': 150, 'knee_l': 142, 'ankle_l': 95,
       'shoulder_r': 32, 'arm_r': 144, 'hand_r': 40,
       'shoulder_l': 150, 'arm_l': 37, 'hand_l': 130}

LEAN = 0   # extra forward lean while walking; 0 = the same pose as Program 1

PINS = {'leg_r': 14, 'knee_r': 13, 'ankle_r': 12,
        'leg_l': 5, 'knee_l': 4, 'ankle_l': 2,
        'shoulder_r': 15, 'arm_r': 25, 'hand_r': 26,
        'shoulder_l': 27, 'arm_l': 32, 'hand_l': 33}

LEG_R = ANG['leg_r'] + LEAN
LEG_L = ANG['leg_l'] - LEAN

srv = {j: PWM(Pin(p, Pin.OUT), freq=50) for j, p in PINS.items()}
pos = dict(ANG)
pos['leg_r'], pos['leg_l'] = LEG_R, LEG_L


def w(joint, deg):
    pos[joint] = int(deg)
    srv[joint].duty(int(deg * 0.56) + 25)


def ramp(target, steps=20, ms=15):
    """Move several joints to new angles at the same time.

    target is a dict like {'shoulder_r': 140, 'hand_r': 90}. Joints that are
    not in target keep their angle. The move is spread over `steps` frames so
    the servos glide instead of jumping - a jump risks a fall.
    """
    start = {j: pos[j] for j in target}
    for i in range(1, steps + 1):
        for j, d in target.items():
            w(j, start[j] + (d - start[j]) * i / steps)
        time.sleep_ms(ms)


def stand(steps=18):
    """Back to the standing pose, whatever the robot was doing before."""
    target = dict(ANG)
    target['leg_r'] = LEG_R
    target['leg_l'] = LEG_L
    ramp(target, steps, 12)


# ---------- 2. A face that shows what the robot thinks ----------
i2c = I2C(scl=Pin(22), sda=Pin(23))
oled = ssd1306.SSD1306_I2C(128, 64, i2c)


def face(mood='idle'):
    """Draw one of three moods with plain rectangles and lines - no bitmaps."""
    oled.fill(0)
    if mood == 'happy':
        oled.fill_rect(40, 24, 10, 4, 1)          # eyes, half closed
        oled.fill_rect(78, 24, 10, 4, 1)
        oled.hline(50, 44, 6, 1)                  # a smile made of three lines
        oled.hline(56, 47, 16, 1)
        oled.hline(72, 44, 6, 1)
    elif mood == 'angry':
        oled.line(38, 20, 52, 27, 1)              # slanted brows
        oled.line(90, 20, 76, 27, 1)
        oled.fill_rect(42, 32, 10, 6, 1)
        oled.fill_rect(76, 32, 10, 6, 1)
        oled.hline(52, 50, 24, 1)                 # flat mouth
    else:                                         # idle
        oled.fill_rect(42, 24, 10, 10, 1)
        oled.fill_rect(76, 24, 10, 10, 1)
        oled.hline(54, 46, 20, 1)
    oled.show()


# ---------- 3. Six actions the voice can trigger ----------
def wave():
    ramp({'shoulder_r': ANG['shoulder_r'] + 130, 'arm_r': 95})
    for _ in range(3):
        ramp({'hand_r': 70}, 6, 20)
        ramp({'hand_r': 110}, 6, 20)
    stand()


def bow():
    ramp({'leg_r': ANG['leg_r'] + 45, 'leg_l': ANG['leg_l'] - 45,
          'knee_r': ANG['knee_r'] + 22, 'knee_l': ANG['knee_l'] - 22,
          'shoulder_r': ANG['shoulder_r'] + 45})
    time.sleep_ms(500)
    stand()


def kick():
    ramp({'leg_r': LEG_R + 12, 'leg_l': LEG_L - 12})        # lean back a little
    ramp({'knee_r': ANG['knee_r'] + 55}, 12, 20)            # wind up
    ramp({'knee_r': ANG['knee_r'], 'ankle_r': ANG['ankle_r'] + 25}, 6, 8)   # kick!
    time.sleep_ms(400)
    stand()


def punch():
    ramp({'shoulder_r': ANG['shoulder_r'] + 110,
          'shoulder_l': ANG['shoulder_l'] - 110,
          'arm_r': ANG['arm_r'] - 60, 'arm_l': ANG['arm_l'] + 60})
    for _ in range(2):
        ramp({'arm_r': ANG['arm_r'], 'arm_l': ANG['arm_l']}, 5, 6)     # out
        ramp({'arm_r': ANG['arm_r'] - 60, 'arm_l': ANG['arm_l'] + 60}, 5, 6)
    stand()


def squat():
    ramp({'leg_r': ANG['leg_r'] + 30, 'leg_l': ANG['leg_l'] - 30,
          'knee_r': ANG['knee_r'] + 30, 'knee_l': ANG['knee_l'] - 30})
    time.sleep_ms(600)
    stand()


def dance():
    bow()
    wave()
    kick()


# ---------- 4. What the AI module says -> what the robot does ----------
# (phrase to look for, face to show, action to run)

# module up in English, just edit the left column.
CMDS = (('挥手', 'happy', wave),
        ('鞠躬', 'happy', bow),
        ('踢球', 'angry', kick),
        ('打拳', 'angry', punch),
        ('蹲下', 'idle', squat),
        ('跳舞', 'happy', dance),
        ('起立', 'idle', stand))

uart = UART(2, 115200)          # GPIO16 = RX, GPIO17 = TX on the ESP32


def listen():
    """Read one line from the AI module, run the first matching command."""
    if not uart.any():
        return
    try:
        line = uart.readline().decode('utf-8').strip()
    except Exception:            # half a line, wrong baud rate, noise
        return
    if not line:
        return
    print('heard:', line)
    for key, mood, action in CMDS:
        if key in line:
            face(mood)
            action()
            face('idle')
            return


# ---------- 5. Run ----------
stand()
face('idle')
print('ready')

while True:
    listen()
    time.sleep_ms(20)            # 50 checks per second is plenty for speech

You control a small biped robot. When I ask you to do something,

If I ask for anything else, answer "好的起立".
🧩 It is worth being precise about this, because it is the most misunderstood part of the project. The speech recognition, the language model and the reasoning all run on the
. What reaches the ESP32 is a short string over two wires. The ESP32 does not know what a word means; it only knows that

🧠 That is why the program is so short, and also why it is reliable: the boundary is text. You can swap the AI module for a phone app, a laptop script or another robot and the ESP32 side does not change at all. The only contract is "send me one of these seven phrases".

📷 The module also has a camera. Ask it "what is in front of you" and it answers in speech - that part needs no code on the robot, because the answer never leaves the module. The robot's job in that conversation is the face on the OLED, not the description.
